rationale: Builds on the current 9x512 reverse-tail best without changing the trained matrix path. After the existing EMA handoff, it briefly roundtrips onto the exact final int8/float-kept manifold and spends only unused train budget on scalar/control and small output-path parameters, with embeddings and block matrices frozen. This directly targets final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact, preserves validation isolation and final eval, avoids intermediate validation, and keeps the artifact format and recurrent-tail export budget intact.
title: Exact-Roundtrip Scalar Calibration Tail
